text: {"features":[{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"How clearly and convincingly the letter explains why this exact Information Security Engineering role is the applicant's intended next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the job only in generic terms and gives little reason this role fits beyond wanting a software or security position."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides one broad reason for interest, such as liking backend work or security, but does not tie it closely to the posting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains a plausible fit using one or two relevant aspects of the role, such as security automation, backend systems, or Google scale."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear, specific rationale tied to several responsibilities or themes in the posting and links them to prior experience or goals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the role feel like the natural continuation of the applicant's trajectory by connecting multiple posting-specific needs to a strong, memorable sense of purpose."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage mindset","description":"How strongly the letter shows appreciation for building foundational tooling whose benefits compound across many teams and systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses only on individual tasks or product work and does not show interest in foundation-layer impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or infrastructure briefly but does not explain why broad downstream impact matters."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some interest in foundational systems or organization-wide impact as part of the role fit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes building systems whose benefits propagate across teams, workflows, or the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Frames the applicant's engineering identity around high-leverage foundational work and directly connects that mindset to security tooling at very large scale."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys an engineering approach centered on failure modes, guardrails, maintainability, and dependable systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not communicate a clear philosophy about reliability, safety, or maintainability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to reliability or security outcomes in passing without linking them to concrete engineering habits."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some attention to failure modes, maintenance, or dependable defaults in the way the applicant works."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes building bounded, maintainable, resilient systems and learning from how systems fail."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes reliability-oriented thinking central to the case for fit, with explicit focus on guardrails, failure modes, quiet resilience, or higher standards for security tooling."}]},{"name":"Formal education level","description":"The strength of the applicant's formal computer science or related technical education as presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only baseline academic preparation, typically a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows baseline academic preparation plus some sign of additional technical study, but no completed advanced degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows unusually advanced graduate-level preparation beyond the baseline, though not a completed doctorate."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a completed PhD or other doctorate in computer science or a related technical field."}]},{"name":"Software delivery experience","description":"The extent of hands-on professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only early-career production experience, typically around the minimum years and with limited evidence of ownership across a small number of services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows clear production exposure but only modest breadth of launches, maintenance responsibility, or service count."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience, typically around three to five years with several production services across testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production engineering maturity, typically around five years with repeated launches or broad ownership across multiple services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production engineering experience, typically around seven years with a substantial record of building, testing, maintaining, and launching multiple services."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Go as a substantive working language for back-end development relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only as part of a background summary and gives little evidence of depth beyond basic professional use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is used professionally but does not show that it is central to important systems work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a regular working language for production services and back-end engineering."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as the primary or most-used language for designing, launching, or operating production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, role-relevant Go ownership by tying it to major systems architecture, service boundaries, or control mechanisms around security or agents."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Python as a substantive language for tooling, automation, services, or agents relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or gives no evidence of meaningful use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions some Python exposure but only at a surface or incidental level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for automation, analysis, prototypes, or internal tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python use in production services, important internal tooling, or agent components that others rely on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong, production-grade Python ownership with clear evidence of building reliable services, automation layers, or agent implementations in Python."}]},{"name":"AI application experience","description":"The extent to which the letter demonstrates practical experience applying AI or LLMs in real software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI experience or only gestures at interest in it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI in broad terms without concrete implementation or deployment detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or shipping AI-backed features in a general but credible way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work with some attention to reliability, evaluation, or model failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial hands-on AI experience in production, including clear evidence of hardening, evaluating, or operationalizing model-backed features."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How well the letter shows experience designing agent-based systems with explicit control, supervision, or boundaries.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or uses the term only abstractly."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agentic work but gives little architectural detail about how the system operates."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent systems with identifiable components such as Python agents and supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a concrete agent architecture with bounded actions, guardrails, permissions, or auditability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates mature agent-system design by clearly showing how agents are empowered yet constrained through services, logging, supervision, or similar controls."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant has built automation for vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any automation for vulnerability or security-report handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in security automation but gives no concrete example of having built it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of automating vulnerability or security-report triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes meaningful triage automation with details such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, role-relevant ownership of vulnerability automation by combining concrete workflow detail with clear evidence of reduced expert toil or faster handling."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"How well the letter demonstrates hands-on experience assessing systems for security risk.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention security assessment work at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to security awareness, reviews, or credentials but gives little evidence of actually performing assessments."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes participating in threat models, reviews, or assessments at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows hands-on assessment experience with concrete methods such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong assessment depth by explaining a practical assessment approach and treating reviews as rigorous engineering work with follow-through."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates strong algorithmic thinking relevant to large-scale tooling and systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention algorithmic work and gives no proxy for strength with data structures or performance-oriented problem solving."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength in generic terms without a concrete technical example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one plausible example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong recent example showing that structure choice or algorithm redesign removed a real bottleneck, inefficiency, or failure mode."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic strength feel central to the applicant's work through especially clear, technically credible examples tied to system design, correctness, or performance."}]},{"name":"Enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping other teams succeed through collaboration, secure defaults, and reduced friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention collaboration, internal users, or helping others adopt secure practices."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Frames security work mainly as individual technical contribution rather than as enablement for other teams."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some awareness of helping developers or working with security specialists."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes making the secure path easier for developers or learning from and partnering with dedicated security teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a strong enablement philosophy by explicitly positioning security tooling as a way to reduce friction, scale scarce expert judgment, and help other teams work securely."}]},{"name":"Technical specificity","description":"The degree to which the letter supports claims with concrete technical details rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims or buzzwords with almost no concrete technical detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few technologies or topics but little detail about what was actually built or how it worked."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives several specific examples of systems, tools, workflows, or technical problems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds claims in clear technical details about architecture, engineering choices, or operational concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels highly concrete throughout, with multiple precise technical details that make the applicant's experience easy to picture and trust."}]},{"name":"Impact evidence","description":"How clearly the letter shows the outcomes of the applicant's work for teams, systems, or workloads.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Makes claims about skills or projects but gives no observable outcomes or practical effects."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at benefits without showing what changed, who benefited, or why the work mattered."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives at least one clear before-and-after result or practical benefit from the work described."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides multiple concrete outcomes such as time saved, queue reduction, bug elimination, improved routing, or better reliability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly ties projects to strong, credible outcomes that show meaningful leverage on team productivity, system quality, or security workload."}]},{"name":"Open-source involvement","description":"The depth of the applicant's contribution to open-source software as evidence of engineering discipline and external collaboration.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only minor or occasional interaction with open source and gives little contribution detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes contributing fixes or patches upstream from time to time."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes regular contribution or maintenance responsibility for an open-source project or framework."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantive open-source stewardship, such as maintaining a project with outside users, reviewing contributions, or managing releases."}]},{"name":"Personal project rigor","description":"The sophistication of self-driven technical work outside the applicant's main job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any personal technical project."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small or generic side project with limited technical complexity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a modest but real personal project that shows initiative and follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial systems-oriented project with nontrivial design, operational, or recovery concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Describes an ambitious, technically demanding project that tackles hard distributed-systems, reliability, consistency, failover, or production-standard engineering problems."}]},{"name":"Security credential strength","description":"The strength of formal security certification evidence presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents no formal security credential."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows informal security learning or interest but no completed credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a baseline security certification such as Security+ or an equivalent fundamentals credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a credential stronger than a baseline awareness certification but not at the level of an advanced hands-on offensive exam."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents an advanced hands-on security credential such as OSCP or an equivalent exam that requires practical exploitation skill."}]},{"name":"Offensive security practice","description":"How much the letter shows ongoing hands-on adversarial practice beyond day-to-day engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any ongoing offensive security practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional security exercises or casual interest without evidence of sustained practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular participation in security exercises such as capture-the-flag competitions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes serious or frequent participation used deliberately to sharpen offensive and defensive thinking."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows unusually strong offensive practice, such as near-top placements or a sustained record of high-level competition performance."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The polish of grammar, spelling, and sentence-level execution in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors that noticeably distract from credibility or readability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible errors or awkward phrasings that a careful review should have caught."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a few noticeable mechanical issues but remains easy to follow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mostly clean and professional with only minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free, polished, and professionally edited in presentation."}]},{"name":"Persuasive structure","description":"How effectively the letter is organized into a coherent case for fit rather than a loose list of claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a disjointed set of statements with weak progression or little cumulative case for fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has some structure but feels checklist-like or only loosely connected to a central argument."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a clear overall case with a workable flow from background to fit to closing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a well-organized, convincing argument that connects experience, motivation, and role needs."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a particularly cohesive and memorable narrative in which each paragraph strengthens the overall case for the applicant."}]}]}
